description: The bar chart illustrates the F1 Score (in percentage) of the MADLLM model and its ablated variants across five different datasets — SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI — for multivariate anomaly detection. The vertical axis represents the F1 Score ranging from 60% to 100%, with tick marks at 10% intervals. The horizontal axis lists the datasets in order: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI. For each dataset, four bars are grouped together, representing: (1) the full MADLLM model (green), (2) MADLLM without prompt pool (blue), (3) MADLLM without feature embedding (purple), and (4) MADLLM without skip embedding (orange). Across most datasets, the full MADLLM (green) achieves the highest or near-highest F1 Score, indicating the importance of its full architecture. Notably, on the WADI dataset, all variants perform lower than on others, with the full model scoring approximately 99% on SMD, 101% on PSM (likely a typo or mislabeling, as F1 scores cannot exceed 100%), around 100% on SWaT, ~90% on SMAP, ~100% on MSL, and ~98% on WADI. The blue bar (w/o prompt pool) generally shows a significant drop, especially on SWaT and SMAP, suggesting the prompt pool contributes substantially to performance. The purple and orange bars show moderate drops compared to the full model, indicating that feature and skip embeddings also play important but less critical roles. The chart is tilted slightly for visual effect, and the legend is placed below the x-axis for clarity.
